decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before completion fo work.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 6 - It is considered that the proposed single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No. 14A Newlands Close and would not be detrimental to the visual amenity of the locality or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003); and is compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Installation of vehicular crossover and erection of a single storey rear extension to flat.
